subject.title: refactor(talk): return emitted events from the realtime session harness

question: Should the Talk/Gateway owners accept this internal event-return seam as the foundation for the linked managed Plugin SDK session feature?
rationale: The seam affects a shared harness and supports a stacked, still-open feature PR; the available context does not establish complete current-main compatibility evidence or owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve the internal seam
options.body: Confirm that the Gateway relay is the intended consumer and land this refactor before reviewing the dependent managed-session feature.

options.title: Keep the seam relay-local
options.body: Require the relay to obtain the needed events without expanding the shared harness contract if owners do not want a reusable internal mode.

recommendation.title: Approve the internal seam
recommendation.body: Confirm that the Gateway relay is the intended consumer and land this refactor before reviewing the dependent managed-session feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged and open related PRs identify this contributor as the recent author of the harness and relay integration; independent ownership history was unavailable.
